plan: Since this is the only round, I will bid slightly below my value to maximize potential profit. Bidding my full value of $34 would leave no room for profit if I win. A bid of $33.9 ensures I win against bids below $33.9 and pay the second-highest bid, maximizing my earnings with the highest chance of winning without overbidding.

My value for the item is $28. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure potential winnings while minimizing potential loss. Bidding exactly $28 is risky if others bid similarly, as I would pay that amount if I win. A bid of $25 is reasonable, as it allows room to profit if the second-highest bid is lower. This bid balances the risk of paying too much with the chance of winning.

My value for the prize is $14. To maximize profit, I should bid less than my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. Bidding slightly below $14, such as $13, balances the risk of losing with the potential for profit. Bids above $14 are dominated as they guarantee a loss if I win. Bids significantly below $14 increase the risk of losing. With no history to learn from, a bid of $13 is strategic.
